guide.intro_tail: Use these steps if you cannot use the store. The browser then loads NeoDM Integration from a folder, and you update it yourself.
guide.manual.heading: Manual install (alternative)
guide.not_found: The extension folder was not found. Reinstall NeoDM to restore it.
guide.remove_why: Two copies of the extension fight over the same downloads, and the browser keeps loading the folder it was first installed from.
guide.same_browsers: The screenshots are from Chrome. Edge and Brave use the same layout, so they apply to all three browsers.

guide.step0.l1: Open the extensions page with the address above.
guide.step0.title: If you already installed NeoDM Integration, remove the old one first.
guide.step1.title: Turn on Developer mode.
guide.step2.l1: The button appears after Developer mode is on.
guide.step2.title: Click Load unpacked.
guide.step3.l1: Paste the path below into the folder picker, or browse to it, then click Select Folder.
guide.step3.title: Choose the NeoDM extension folder.
guide.step4.l1: Pin it from the puzzle piece menu in the toolbar.
guide.step4.l2: Open its popup and click Test connection. It should say Host connected.
guide.step4.title: Check that NeoDM Integration shows version {0} and is switched on.
guide.step5.l1: Repeat step 0, then step 2. Or click the reload arrow on the NeoDM Integration card.
guide.step5.l2: Chrome and Edge show a notice about developer mode extensions each time the browser starts. Close it. The extension keeps working.
guide.step5.title: After a NeoDM update that changes the extension, install it again.
guide.store.btn: Install from the Chrome Web Store
guide.store.heading: Recommended: install from the Chrome Web Store
guide.store.opening: The Chrome Web Store page is opening in your default browser.
guide.store.other: Edge and Brave can use the Chrome Web Store too. Edge first asks you to allow extensions from other stores.
guide.store.text: This is the easiest way. The store installs the extension and keeps it up to date by itself.
guide.trouble1.a: That is expected for a .crx file. Do not open the .crx. Use Load unpacked with the folder from step 3.
guide.trouble1.q: The browser blocks the extension and mentions its store.
guide.trouble2.a: Install NeoDM with its setup program, which registers the browser connection. Then restart the browser and try again.
guide.trouble2.q: Test connection says the host is unavailable.
guide.trouble3.a: The browser remembers the folder path. Remove the extension and load the folder again from step 3.
guide.trouble3.q: The extension stopped working after I moved or deleted the folder.
guide.where.left: on the left side of the page
guide.where.top_right: at the top right of the page

options.text.neodm_looks_at_the_browser_: NeoDM looks at the browser registration and the helper a few minutes after start, then less often while everything works, and repairs what it can. Help > Browser connection still works when this is off.
options.text.not_proxied_dht_local_peer_: Not proxied: DHT, local peer discovery, UPnP and UDP trackers use UDP, which this proxy support cannot carry. While peer connections use the proxy they are switched off so your address is not exposed. Incoming connections still arrive directly.

options.text.replaces_the_themes_accent_: Replaces the theme's accent in buttons, progress bars, selection and focus rings. Leave empty to use the theme's own.
options.text.restart_required_connection: Restart required: connection changes take effect the next time NeoDM starts. Running downloads are not modified.
options.text.restart_required_new_downlo: Restart required: new downloads use this destination after restarting NeoDM. Existing downloads keep their saved paths.
options.text.saves_downloads_into_subfol: Saves downloads into subfolders of the download folder by file type (Programs, Compressed, Music, Video, Documents). Other files stay in the base folder. Turn off to save everything in one folder.
options.text.seeding_torrents_never_coun: Seeding torrents never count as active downloads for When all downloads finish. Ratio counts data sent versus received since the torrent last started. Network changes apply immediately after saving.

options.text.use_relative_paths_e_g_prog: Use relative paths (e.g., 'Programs') or absolute paths. Files not matching any category go to the base download folder.
